chapter.verse: Hih pen Jesu Khris' lahkhiat mangmuhna hi a, a sawt lo-a a piang pelmawh ding thute a silate' tungah lahsawn dingin Pasian in amah a piak ahi hi. Amah in a silapa John' kiangah a vanmite sawlkhia-in hih thu laktel hi.
John in zong Pasian' thu ahi zongin, Jesu Khris' teci panna ahi zongin, a muh bangbang teci pang hi.
Hih kamsanna thute a simkhia mi thuphangah hi a, a kiseh hun hong nai ta ahih manin hih sunga kigelh thute za-in a zui mi thuphangah ahi hi.

Keimah John in Asia gam sunga om pawlpi sagihte kong hopih hi: Note' tungah hehpihna leh nopna lemna hong om ta hen. Tu laitaka om, a om ngeisa, a hong pai ding Pasian' kiangpan ahi zongin, ama' kumpi-tokhom mai-a om kha sagihte' kiangpan ahi zongin,
a citak teci pang, misite' lakpana tacil, leitung kumpite a ukpa Jesu Khris' kiangpan ahi zongin, a tunga thuphate hong tung ta hen. Eite hong itin i mawhnate pan ama' sisan tawh hong suaktasak,
ama' Pasian leh Pa' adingin kumpigam khat leh siampite hong suaksak ahi Jesu Khris' tungah a tawntung a tawntungin minpha leh ukzawhna om ta hen. Amen.

En un, meiilomte tawh amah hong pai ding a, mit khempeuh leh amah a dawtlumte nangawn in amah mu ding uh hi. Leitung minam khempeuh zong ama' hangin kap ngeingai ding uh hi. Tua bang hi takpi ding hi. Amen.
Tu laitaka om, a om ngeisa, a hong pai ding, Vanglianpa, Topa Pasian in, “Kei pen Alpha leh Omega ka hi hi,” ci hi.

Jesu sunga om gentheihna, kumpigam leh lungduai thuakzawhna cih thute ah note' kithuahpih ahi, na sanggampa uh keimah John pen Pasian' thu leh Jesu' teci panna hangin Patmos a kici tuikulh tungah ka om hi.
Topa' ni-in Kha tawh ka om a, ka nunglam pan pengkul ging bangin awging lianpi khat hih bangin ka za hi:
“Na muh teng laihual khat ah gelh inla Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia leh Laodicea khuate-a om pawlpi sagihte' tungah khak in.”
Tua ciangin kei hong hopih awging en dingin ka kihei a, ka kihei ciangin kham meivaktau sagih ka mu hi.
Meivaktaute' laizang ah puantual a silh, a awm ah kham awmgak a vial, mihing' tapa tawh a kibang khat om hi.
A lu tunga samzangte tuumul leh vuk bangin paak hi. A mitte meikuang tawh kibang hi.
A khete meikhuk ah a kihalsan sumngo siang tawh kibang a, a awging pen tui tampi ging tawh kibang hi.
A taklam khut ah aksi sagih tawi-in a kam panin langnih-hiam namsau khat dawkkhia hi. A maitang pen thaneihzah-a a taang ni tawh kibang hi.
Amah ka muh ciangin a khe-phung ah misi bangin ka puk hi. Ahi zongin ka tungah a taklam khut hong nga-in hih bangin hong ci hi: “Lau kei in, kei pen a masabel leh a nunungbel ka hi hi.
A nungta mipa zong ka hi hi. Ka si ngei a, en in, tu-in a tawntung a tawntungin a nungta ka hi hi. Tua banah Sihna leh Leinuaim tawhtangte ka nei hi.
Tua ahih manin na muh khitsa thute, tu-a om thute leh tu khit-a hong piang ding thute, gelhkhia in.
Meivaktau sagihte leh ka taklam khut sunga na muh aksi sagihte ii a thusim uh tawh kisai-in aksi sagih pen pawlpi sagihte' vanmite hi a, meivaktau sagih pen pawlpi sagihte ahi uh hi.”
